services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Walk amongst the dead and discover the rich tapestry of history and heritage on our cemetery tours at Forest Cemetery. Nestled in the heart of the city, Forest Cemetery is more than just a resting place; it’s a living museum where history and nature converges. Tours take place at desk on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays. Discover the stories of those whose lives ended in violence. From shocking crimes and mysterious deaths to infamous local tragedies, this tour examines the real events that left their mark on North Idaho history. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Whether you're looking for beautiful outdoor venue or a charming little chapel, the Museum of North Idaho is your top choice for a memorable wedding venue. Step back in time and say "I do" in the charm of yesteryear at our historical Fort Sherman Chapel. Nestled in a bygone era, our venue boasts timeless elegance and vintage allure. Experience the romance of a century past as you exchange your views in Coeur d'Alene's oldest building. Surrounded by majestic pine trees and nestled up against Tubbs Hill, the JC White House is our newest venue and is sure to be the best that downtown Coeur d'Alene has to offer.
